headline.caveat: multi-generational GPU purchases starting with 1GW of Instinct MI450 in 2H2026; contract dollars undisclosed — AMD has pointed to 'tens of billions' per GW and >$100B four-year revenue opportunity

realized_to_date.caveat: first 1GW deploying 2H2026; no revenue recognized from the agreement through AMD FY2025

nature_md: Definitive agreement (Oct 6, 2025) making AMD a 'core strategic compute partner': OpenAI will deploy 6GW of AMD Instinct GPUs across multiple generations, beginning with a 1GW MI450 rack-scale deployment in 2H2026. Purchases are tied to deployment milestones rather than a disclosed fixed dollar commitment. The deal came paired with a warrant for up to 160M AMD shares issued to OpenAI (see related edge) — the buy side and the equity sweetener must be read together.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Hardware purchases expensed/capitalized as deployed (much of the fleet will sit in partner data centers). Milestone-gated structure means OpenAI controls the pace — commitment converts to spend only as gigawatts land.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: AMD recognizes product revenue on shipment — but net of contra-revenue from the OpenAI warrant as tranches vest (per AMD's FY2025 10-K/A, no impact yet since no vesting conditions have been met). Reported AMD data-center revenue from this deal will therefore understate gross selling prices.

events.title: AMD and OpenAI announce 6GW multi-generation GPU partnership
